text:
Ravi: noticed onboarding sample flaky when running on Pixel emulator (API 34). Retrofit + OkHttp combo sometimes replays requests with stale auth header and triggers duplicate refreshes. Repro and short logs below.

Keiko: can you paste client config + concise logs?

Ravi: client: ```kotlin
val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .addInterceptor(AuthInterceptor())
  .authenticator(TokenAuthenticator())
  .retryOnConnectionFailure(true)
  .build()
``` logs:
```
I/Auth: request -> Authorization: Bearer old
W/OkHttp: 401 /v1/items
I/Authenticator: refresh start id=xx1
I/Authenticator: refresh done id=xx1
I/Auth: request -> Authorization: Bearer old (concurrent)
I/Authenticator: refresh start id=xx1 (duplicate)
```

Tom: two quick causes we see: 1) interceptor captured token earlier (Call creation vs send time) so concurrent flows send old header; 2) retryOnConnectionFailure can cause low-level replays overlapping auth flows.

Keiko: fixes we use in product samples: - make interceptor evaluate token lazily at intercept() time (provider lambda) so header is chosen right before send; - add a refresh mutex/Deferred so only the first 401 triggers refresh, others await; - set `.retryOnConnectionFailure(false)` for auth-sensitive clients.

Ravi: tried lazy interceptor + a simple CompletableDeferred-based coordinator; flakiness dropped to zero locally. Pushed PR draft `devex/lazy-auth-coordinator` with README note.

ci-bot: Build 4301 (emulator API 34) - onboarding-sample tests passed.

Tom: follow-ups: add small e2e that simulates parallel 401s, document call-creation vs send-time gotcha in SDK docs, and add a helper factory `OkHttpClients.authSafe(tokenProvider)` that wires lazy interceptor + disabled retry + refresh coordinator.

Ravi: will open tickets and update sample README. Thanks! :thumbsup:
